parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paged query.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The timestamp of the end time.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: RelateInfo
parameters.description: Specifies whether to associate extended information.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The timestamp of the start time.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description: The ID of the task to retrieve.

parameters.name: TaskType
parameters.description:
The task type. Valid values:
- **IMAGE_SCAN**: image scanning
- **IMAGE\_REGISTRY\_PULL**: image asset synchronization.
